mo_ta_cong_viec:
Annam Software is the Vietnam development center of Omnicasa, a Belgian software company building CRM solutions used by hundreds of real estate agencies in Europe.
Our HCMC team develops and operates our web platform, mobile applications, APIs and integrations.
We are looking for an experienced DevOps / Senior System Engineer to join our infrastructure team and take an important role in running and improving our Linux and Kubernetes environments.
 
The role
You will work hands-on with our production infrastructure, with a strong focus on Kubernetes, Linux, networking and automation.
This is not a role where you simply follow predefined procedures. We are looking for someone who can investigate problems independently, propose solutions and take ownership of infrastructure from implementation through production.
You'll work with both our development and infrastructure teams to make sure our systems are reliable, secure and easy to deploy.
Run and improve our Kubernetes clusters, including deployments, scaling, upgrades and troubleshooting
Manage and optimize our Linux-based infrastructure
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for our web, API and mobile projects
Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, Helm and related tools
Create and maintain Helm charts for application deployments
Configure and troubleshoot networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, load balancers and firewalls
Set up and improve monitoring, logging and alerting
Manage secrets and contribute to infrastructure security and hardening
Work with developers to containerize and deploy applications
Automate infrastructure tasks using Bash, Python or similar scripting languages
Maintain infrastructure configuration using tools such as Puppet
Work with virtualization environments such as Proxmox and VMware
Document infrastructure, procedures and troubleshooting steps
Participate in a predictable on-call rotation for critical infrastructure issues
yeu_cau:
What you bring
3+ years of experience in DevOps, system engineering or infrastructure
Strong hands-on experience with Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS or similar)
At least 2 years of practical Kubernetes experience, preferably running production environments
Hands-on experience with Docker and Helm
Good understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, routing and load balancing
Experience with CI/CD, such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar
Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management
Ability to write and debug scripts using Bash, Python or similar
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to research and solve problems independently
Basic working knowledge of English
Nice to have
Experience with Terraform
Experience with Puppet
Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Zabbix or similar
Experience with Vault, Infisical or other secrets-management tools
Experience with VMware vSphere or Proxmox
Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
Experience deploying .NET, Node.js or Next.js applications
CKA or CKAD certification
